record.question: A Constitutional Bench must consist of not fewer than how many Judges when deciding a case involving the validity of a central law under the Constitution?
record.explanation: Answer B: 5. Article 145(3) sets a five-judge minimum for a case involving a substantial question of constitutional interpretation. Reference: https://www.indiacode.nic.in/bitstream/123456789/16124/1/the_constitution_of_india.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: October 2025 examination (cover page); answer time-sensitive wording as of then.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
